Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America does the Lord’s work to protect unborn children across America, and I’m deeply honored to have their support. 

In the Florida State House and in Congress I have never wavered in protecting the unborn — as Governor, I never will. 

Together, we will keep Florida the most pro-family state in the country.
posts.summary: Opposes abortion, pledges lifelong protection of unborn children
